changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO product_survey_participation (id, survey_id, account_id, workspace_id, status, answers_json, invited_at, decided_at) SELECT s.id, s.survey_id, s.account_id, s.workspace_id, CASE s.disposition WHEN 'DISMISSED' THEN 'DECLINED' ELSE s.disposition END, CASE WHEN s.answers_json IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE question.node ->> 'type' WHEN 'RATING' THEN jsonb_build_object('questionId', question.node ->> 'id', 'rating', btrim(answer.value)::int) WHEN 'SINGLE_CHOICE' THEN jsonb_build_object('questionId', question.node ->> 'id', 'choices', jsonb_build_array(answer.value)) ELSE jsonb_build_object('questionId', question.node ->> 'id', 'text', btrim(answer.value)) END ORDER BY question.position) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v.questions_json) WITH ORDINALITY AS question(node, position) JOIN jsonb_each_text(s.answers_json) AS answer(key, value) ON answer.key = question.node ->> 'id' WHERE btrim(answer.value) <> '' ), '[]'::jsonb) END, s.created_at, s.created_at FROM product_survey_submission s JOIN product_survey v ON v.id = s.survey_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_survey_participation p WHERE p.survey_id = s.survey_id AND p.account_id = s.account_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
